capabilities.registration: Specification extension under programme issue #8/#56 pending registration; existing linked issues do not silently acquire new acceptance.
dataRequirements: Actual selected framework and recorded evidence; current source largely definitions/previews.
acceptance: Missing qualification is distinguishable from a negative qualification outcome.
tests: Unknown framework/version, incomplete evidence, permissions and explicit unknown state.

capabilities.capability: Persist and share permitted report definitions and restore saved views
capabilities.registration: Existing canonical scope; bounded contribution does not close the issue.
dataRequirements: Versioned report definition, ownership/sharing policy and supported fields.
acceptance: A shared definition grants no data access; recipient reruns under own permissions; unsupported versions remain recoverable.
tests: Creator/recipient scope mismatch, unknown version, preference restore and permission change.

capabilities.capability: Export filtered tables with identical calculations and access rules
capabilities.registration: Existing canonical scope; bounded contribution does not close the issue.
dataRequirements: Qualified existing export permission/path and current report definition.
acceptance: Export totals/rows match report scope; export cannot bypass data.export or viewer visibility; headings and units localized.
tests: Export permission, formula injection, pagination completeness, revocation and decimal precision.
capabilities.currentSourceNote: All contributing-deal metric tables have a permission-checked complete CSV download with a 100-row cap. Hosted qualification and export for the remaining report families are pending.

capabilities.capability: Missing/stale/partial/insufficient/permission-limited/error/zero states and freshness
capabilities.registration: Existing canonical scope; bounded contribution does not close the issue.
dataRequirements: Freshness, history coverage, sample and source health metadata.
acceptance: Do not coerce unavailable/error into zero; show measurement explanation and one useful recovery/setup action.
tests: Every state, stale refresh, partial source, retry and empty eligible population.

capabilities.capability: Governed input/import/integration contracts for missing business sources
capabilities.registration: Existing canonical scope; bounded contribution does not close the issue.
dataRequirements: Named sources/owners for campaign, delivery, cost, billing, contract, order, ticket, time, survey and product events; schema, auth, provenance, retention, correction and dedup policy.
acceptance: Inspect real owning source before extension; implement persisted bounded intake/import/setup states where absent.
Draft/synthetic contract is not live source qualification; missing source prerequisites remain delivery scope.
tests: Native intake validation, replay/conflict, source revocation, correction, identity, bounded payload and database persistence.
capabilities.currentSourceNote: Versioned payload validators, an atomic planner and an unnumbered private custody writer are implemented in source. Native fixture qualification, installed storage, authenticated adapters, real sources and privacy lifecycle remain open. See governed-inputs.md.

capabilities.capability: Viewer/account timezone and Gregorian/Iranian reporting boundaries
capabilities.registration: Existing canonical scope; bounded contribution does not close the issue.
dataRequirements: Independent locale/calendar/timezone preferences and canonical instants.
acceptance: Use true supported Iranian day/month/quarter/year boundaries with half-open instants; changing labels alone is insufficient.
Civil-date comparison periods of different lengths are explicit.
tests: Nowruz/leap year, DST gap/fold, near-midnight instants and mismatched account/viewer timezone.

capabilities.capability: English/German/Farsi, RTL, numbers and currency display

acceptance: Preserve raw names and canonical currency; intentional chart chronology and logical RTL layout.
tests: FA/DE/EN, Persian/Latin digits, IRR/toman fractional values and narrow-width truncation.

capabilities.capability: Apply UI Skills and Mobbin-informed craft across actual components
capabilities.registration: Existing canonical scope; bounded contribution does not close the issue.
dataRequirements: Supplied interface-design/baseline-ui texts; current Warpdrive theme/shell/components.
acceptance: Overview focuses results, meaningful changes, bottleneck and actions; Marketing/Pipeline/Forecast/Customers and Activities provide coherent depth.

Preserve brand tokens, precise tabular typography, restrained semantics, polished filters/tables/drawers and clear states; visually inspect actual rendered desktop/mobile, light/dark and FA/DE/EN RTL.

capabilities.capability: Bounded aggregation, pagination, lazy loading and measured workloads
capabilities.registration: Existing canonical scope; bounded contribution does not close the issue.
dataRequirements: Representative seeded/approved workload and query plans; cache metadata.
acceptance: Do not fetch complete deal history to browser; constrain jobs and summaries, expose freshness.
Record dataset size/scope, hardware/runtime, cache state and timings; no invented benchmark claims.
tests: First/repeat read benchmarks, pagination bounds, cancellation, cache isolation and query plans under allocated heavy slot.

capabilities.capability: Reproducible validation and insufficient-data fallbacks for advanced models
capabilities.registration: Specification extension under programme issue #8/#56 pending registration; existing linked issues do not silently acquire new acceptance.
dataRequirements: Qualified outcomes, immutable dataset/cutoff/model version and prespecified temporal evaluation.
acceptance: Prevent leakage; record numerical validation, bias/calibration/uncertainty, limitations and data sufficiency.
No model output qualifies itself merely because mathematics ran.
tests: Temporal splits, missing/censored labels, leakage controls, baseline comparison, drift and fallback.

capabilities.capability: Respect module ownership, shared contracts, peer work and excluded workspace
capabilities.registration: Existing canonical scope; bounded contribution does not close the issue.
dataRequirements: Live issue ownership and stable adapters; no contact with existing chats authorized.
acceptance: Do not edit Goals authoring or excluded codex/deal-workspace-premium workspace; isolate work and preserve reference/peer files.
Check live ownership before overlapping shared events/history/marketing/report contracts.
tests: Scoped diff review and exact source ownership/issue mapping.

capabilities.capability: Reviewable canonical-linked increments, exact evidence and integration boundaries
capabilities.registration: Existing canonical scope; bounded contribution does not close the issue.
dataRequirements: Fresh one-use queue allocation before heavy type/lint/build/database/browser validation.
acceptance: Clean task-owned commits/PRs with canonical issue mapping; final programme merge/publication expressly authorized by the user after required qualification.
Source implemented, integrated/CI, accepted, released, deployed and real-source qualified are independent gates.
Retain all unfinished/advanced scope and actual failures; never infer whole-programme completion from a slice.
tests: Focused calculations plus allocated real backend/integration tests, UI behaviour and visual review at exact revision; cleanup evidence.

qualification.testsListed: Planned acceptance checks, not claims that tests exist or passed. Existing baseline code is inspected source, not current installed acceptance.
qualification.newScopeRegistration: Advanced acceptance not explicitly in original deliverable issues is retained as specification extension under programme issue #8/#56 pending registration. No canonical IDs or closure are invented.
qualification.completionPolicy: No aggregate completion percentage. Whole programme remains incomplete until all requested implementation and qualification prerequisites are resolved.
